help_app_desc: A simple app to manually record your transfers and withdrawals.
faq_q1: How do I add a record?
faq_a1: Tap the '+' button on the Home screen. Choose Transfer or Withdrawal, enter the amount and fee, select a payment method, then tap Save.
faq_q2: What is the difference between Transfer and Withdrawal?
faq_a2: Transfer means you sent money to someone (e.g. via KPay). Withdrawal means you or a customer cashed out money.
faq_q3: How do I add or edit payment methods?
faq_a3: Go to Settings → Payment Methods. You can add a new method, edit existing ones, or toggle them on/off.
faq_q4: How do I protect my records with a PIN?
faq_a4: Go to Settings → PIN Change. Set a 4–6 digit PIN. The app will ask for the PIN every time it opens.
faq_a5: Yes. Open the record from History, then tap the Delete icon. You can also delete all records under a ledger by deleting the ledger.
tc_subtitle: Please read these terms before using the app.
tc_about_desc: Canolia POS is a manual record-keeping tool. You enter transfer and withdrawal amounts yourself. The app does not connect to any bank or payment gateway.
tc_s1_1: This app is for personal record-keeping only.
tc_s1_2: All data you enter is stored locally on your device.
tc_s1_2_accurate: Records are stored locally by default. If you sign in and use cloud backup or sync, selected data is sent to Firebase so that feature can work.
tc_s1_3: You are responsible for the accuracy of the records you add.
tc_s2_1: Your data stays on your device and is never uploaded.
tc_s2_1_accurate: Most records stay on your device. Data you choose to sync is sent to Firebase for cloud backup and synchronisation.
tc_s2_2: Use the PIN lock feature to protect your records.
tc_s2_3: We do not collect or share any personal information.
tc_s2_3_accurate: We do not sell personal information or use it for third-party advertising. Google Sign-In and optional cloud sync use Firebase as described in this policy.
tc_s3_1: This app does not process real payments or transactions.
tc_s3_2: The developer is not responsible for any financial decisions based on records in this app.
